note: The same traced module, moved with .to(device) and nothing else. The output difference is the accelerator's arithmetic, not a different graph.

Median of three measurement blocks; the spread between them is reported, because Metal compiles shaders lazily and a single block reports whichever warm-up state the machine was in.
